description: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of “Average Performance” between two methods — “Standard” (gray) and “Ours” (blue) — across three categories: “Base,” “CORGI,” and a third unlabeled category represented by a gray bar at the far right. The vertical y-axis is labeled “Average Performance” and ranges from 48 to 62, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The horizontal x-axis lists the three categories. In the “Base” category, only the “Ours” method is shown, with a performance value of approximately 59.5. In the “CORGI” category, the “Standard” method achieves a performance of about 51.5, while “Ours” reaches approximately 59.5, resulting in a stacked bar where the blue portion sits atop the gray. In the third category, only the “Standard” method is displayed, with a performance of roughly 53.5. A legend in the upper left corner identifies the gray bars as “Standard” and the blue bars as “Ours.” The chart visually emphasizes that “Ours” consistently outperforms “Standard” where both are present, and the third category appears to represent a baseline or control condition for “Standard” alone.
